description: Department of Census and Statistics - National Consumer Price Index for the Month of September 2019 was 130.6
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for September 2019, published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). The content represents statistical information publication, which falls under general administrative matters not covered by Types 1-9, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
